snippet.title: Sin and Serve - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Sin and Serve is a dark comedy, shift-based cooking management sim set in Hell. 
Cook for sinners, harvest their souls, and decide whose side you're really on.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4434410/
